## Documented role

The [IFRC “Our Team” page](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd) (inspected) states that Joseph Theriault has been president of the IFRC board since May 2014; that he worked as a home support worker, residential care attendant, and for CSIL employers; and that he “worked alongside Paul and others as pioneers of the individual funding project; then known as Enhanced Consumer Participation Model [ECPM].” It also states that he travelled the province on CSIL and gave workshops through Capilano Community College.

Those are IFRC statements. This archive has not inspected ECPM manuals or workshop handouts that would test them.
